'''Jet''' is a non-economic dark gray [[stone]] found in large [[cluster]]s in [[sedimentary layer]]s. It is ''not'' [[magma-safe]], and may only be used where any other stone would suffice, aside from one remarkable property.

Jet is the most [[density|lightweight]] stone besides [[raw adamantine]] and [[lignite]], so it is preferable for making [[large pot]]s and other commonly-[[hauling|hauled]] items, and absolutely inappropriate for [[trap|stone-fall traps]] and [[catapult]]s. Likewise, jet [[craft]]s are even more lightweight than normal crafts; this can be very helpful for maximizing [[caravan]] output.

In real life, jet is actually a product of decaying wood under extreme pressure, and is an extremely low grade of [[lignite]]. In DF, however, jet is not a source of [[fuel]]. Since it is very soft and easily carved, historically it has been a popular source of jewelry and [[finished goods|crafts]].
